about_the_game:
Rise up to new heights to take down your opponents with the Climber Gear Set for Security.

Contains five different cosmetic gear pieces:

- Climber Helmet

- Climber Gloves

- Climber Top

- Climber Bottom

- Climber Boots

These items are unlocked in-game immediately upon purchase and can be combined with other cosmetic gear pieces. They can be equipped in-game in the Customization menu, which can be accessed from the Main menu.

The Climber Gear Set is included in the Shell Shock Set Bundle.
